transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been really hard on myself lately. I keep thinking I’m not actually “senior” material at work, like I somehow fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I really can. It’s been weighing on me.
Did these thoughts start after a specific change or event at work?
Yeah, I think so. It really became noticeable about a month ago, after they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties. Since then I’ve been more up and down about it.
If the senior analyst duties were taken away, do you think these thoughts would mostly go away?

Maybe some of it would ease up, yeah. But the main thing is I keep beating myself up about not really being senior material, like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I can handle it. So if they took it away, I might just see that as proof I couldn’t do it.
Because of these thoughts, has your work performance actually been suffering?

A little, yeah. I’m still getting to work and doing the job, but I’m second-guessing myself more, so I double-check things a lot more than I used to. And outside of work I’ve kind of pulled back from friends and family because I don’t really trust my mood or my judgment lately.
Outside of the situation with the senior analyst duties, do you also find yourself worrying a lot about other parts of your life?
Not really, no. I mean, I worry about normal stuff here and there, but I haven’t noticed it taking over other parts of my life the same way. It’s mostly tied to what’s going on at work.
Before you were asked to cover the senior analyst duties, had you already been feeling this way about yourself for a long time?

Yeah, I think so. Looking back, these low periods where I feel guilty or down on myself have been coming and going for maybe… about eleven months now. It got sharper with the senior duties, but it wasn’t completely new.
Have you been feeling down or hard on yourself most days for at least two years?
No, not two years. Looking back, it’s been more like off and on for about eleven months that I’ve had these low, guilty stretches.
Do these feelings about work seem stronger than you would expect for what’s actually happening at your job?

Yeah, I think they probably are stronger than what’s actually happening. I mean, the work is harder, but I keep taking it as proof that I’m not really senior material, like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I can.
Has this been upsetting enough that it feels hard to function in your day-to-day life?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still getting to work and doing what I have to do, but it takes more effort. I find myself double-checking things a lot more than usual. And outside of work, I’ve kind of pulled back from friends and family because I don’t really trust my mood or my judgment lately.
During these low periods, do you lose interest or enjoyment in things you usually like?

Yeah, I do. Stuff I normally enjoy, like grilling on the weekend, going fishing, or just putting on a record… lately I’ll think about it and then just leave everything sitting there. I don’t really care enough to do it.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… most days, I’d say. It’s like there’s this heavy, low feeling hanging around, and I’m just getting through work and home with everything kind of dulled down.
Over the past two weeks, have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, I have. Some mornings I wake up way too early thinking about client tickets and then I can’t get back to sleep. Other times I technically sleep enough hours, but I still wake up feeling worn out.
Over the past two weeks, has your appetite changed noticeably?
Yeah, a bit. My appetite’s been off… I’ll just grab a few bites or skip supper altogether. I’ve noticed my belt feels a little looser, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
Over the past two weeks, have you had thoughts that you’d be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But… yeah, I do catch myself thinking sometimes it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up one morning.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty nearly every day?

Yeah… I have. I keep beating myself up, thinking I’m not really senior material at work, like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I can handle more than I actually can. It’s been on my mind a lot.
Over the past two weeks, have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?
I don’t think so. I mean, I feel slowed down in my head sometimes, but I haven’t noticed myself talking slower or moving differently. No one’s mentioned it to me either.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy nearly every day?
Yeah, I’d say so. By the time I get home from work, I’m pretty drained. Even small stuff like checking the mail or loading the dishwasher feels like it takes more effort than it should.
Even when you’re not thinking about work, do you still feel down most of the day?
Yeah… even when I’m not thinking about work, it’s still there most days. Just this heavy, low feeling, like I’m getting through the day but everything feels kind of muted.
